data.name: NoObjectMatchingRules
data.value: No Object Matching Rules have been defined. While valid, this is not recommended. Object Matching Rules help minimize synchronization errors in uncommon, but important scenarios

data.name: NoAttributeFlowRules
data.value: No Attribute Flow Rules have been defined. While valid, this means no data will flow between the two systems

data.name: CredentialAttributeFlow
data.value: The Attribute Flow using '{0}' must be removed: it holds credentials, which JIM never imports or exports through an Attribute Flow. JIM delivers passwords only through Password Synchronization, on Connected Systems whose Connector supports it.

data.name: CredentialLikeAttributeFlow
data.value: The Attribute Flow targeting '{0}' looks like it may carry a password. If it does, use Password Synchronization on the Connected System instead: a password flowed as an attribute is stored in Metaverse Object and Connected System Object attribute values, change history, Pending Exports, export previews, search results and database backups. If this attribute is not a password, no action is needed.
